caption: The drawing features a single object: a lidded glass jar or goblet set on a stemmed base. The jar is transparent with a light aquamarine or greenish-blue tint and is depicted with swirling, spiral patterns along its surface, both on the bowl and the lid. The lid fits onto the top and has a rounded knob handle, also with a spiral or twisted design. The stem is shaped with a rounded, bulging section and narrows before flaring out into a flat, round base. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations. The glass object is centered in the composition and rendered in fine detail, showing highlights and shading to emphasize its glossy, reflective surface. There is a faint handwritten note near the bottom left corner of the paper, but no other markings or embellishments.
title: Sugar Bowl
